name: r3_setB_v1
purpose: Prompt R3 Part 2, Set B: 10 cases x 3 runs on the laptop, graded by hand under the owner's 13 Nov standard (number standard v2). New wording; every named / IN player has exactly ONE player-lookup match (checked by the plan step, before any model call).

placeholders.p1: the first named player of case 6
placeholders.in8: the player brought in in case 8
placeholders.in9: the player brought in in case 9

turns: Give me a full review of my squad for the next three gameweeks, player by player.

cases.what: a 3-gameweek transfer plan using free transfers
turns: What transfers should I make over the next 3 gameweeks with the free transfers I have?

cases.what: top 8 forwards, next 4 gameweeks, table with price and fixtures
turns: Show me a table of the eight best forwards for the next four gameweeks, with price and fixtures.
Starting from scratch with £100m, what's the strongest squad I could pick?
Who should get the armband this gameweek, and why him?
How do {p1} and {p2} compare over the coming gameweeks?

cases.what: which of my players may rise / fall in price
turns: Are any of my players close to a price rise or a price drop?

cases.what: swap preview then no -> 'No change made.', 0 writes
swap preview then continue -> asks Yes / No, 0 writes; then yes -> saved once
General mode: best-value defenders under £5.0m, next 5 gameweeks
turns: Which defenders under £5.0m are the best value over the next 5 gameweeks?

fallbacks.rule: used in this fixed order only when a name no longer has a single match, or its swap no longer previews as legal, on the refreshed laptop database; the plan file records which was used and why
